newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks stage modest rebound but trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks stage modest rebound but trade thin.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rebounded on Wednesday from a sharp tumble the previous day, helped by bargain-hunting and seasonal cheer on Wall Street.
Brokers said that while there was no supportive news in the market, worries about the extent of Tuesday's slide had investors hunting for attractive buys and covering short positions in thin trade.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 average closed with solid gains, up 387.70 points or 2.02 percent at 19,549.41.
The average had fallen 528.75 points or 2.69 percent to a 12-month low of 19,161.71 on Tuesday, depressed by concerns about the impact of fiscal tightening next year on Japan's economic recovery.
March Nikkei futures finished up 280 at 19,530.
A Christmas Eve rally on Wall Street helped brighten sentiment, brokers said.
